Thank you for considering a career at Ensemble!

Ensemble is a leading provider of technology-enabled revenue cycle management solutions for health systems, including hospitals and affiliated physician groups. They offer end-to-end revenue cycle solutions as well as a comprehensive suite of point solutions to clients across the country.

Ensemble keeps communities healthy by keeping hospitals healthy. We recognize that healthcare requires a human touch, and we believe that every touch should be meaningful. This is why our people are the most important part of who we are. By empowering them to challenge the status quo, we know they will be the difference!

O.N.E Purpose:

  • Customer Obsession: Consistently provide exceptional experiences for our clients, patients, and colleagues by understanding their needs and exceeding their expectations.

  • Embracing New Ideas: Continuously innovate by embracing emerging technology and fostering a culture of creativity and experimentation.

  • Striving for Excellence: Execute at a high level by demonstrating our “Best in KLAS” Ensemble Difference Principles and consistently delivering outstanding results.

The Opportunity:

By embodying our core purpose of customer obsession, new ideas, and driving innovation, and delivering excellence, you will help ensure that every touchpoint is meaningful and contributes to our mission of redefining the possible in healthcare.

Provide Compliance Program leadership for assigned service lines and/or locations, with primary accountability for the oversight of Compliance investigations — ensuring that reported concerns and suspected violations of the Compliance Program are evaluated, investigated, and resolved. This role also serves as a Compliance Liaison to assigned Ensemble clients and/or service lines in accordance with the Compliance Liaison SOP.

II. Job Competencies

Competency Description

Leadership Decision

Making Makes day-to-day leadership decisions by securing and comparing information from multiple sources to identify issues; commits to an action after weighing alternative solutions against important criteria; effectively communicates decisions to the appropriate people and teams and holds them accountable. Drives results.

Delegation Successfully shares authority and responsibilities with others to move decision making and accountability downward through the organization while accomplishing strategic priorities; maintains personal ownership of outcomes without excessive involvement.

Leading Teams Inspires and sustains team unity and engagement by developing, motivating, and guiding the team to achieve results together through productive relationships and work.

Executive

Communication Clearly and succinctly conveys information and ideas; communicates in a focused and compelling way that captures and holds others’ attention (appropriate, impactful, and clear).

Program/Project

Management Demonstrates high accountability and responsibility for projects and programs from inception through completion/implementation; manages budget and resource planning and awareness to ensure maximized output, reduced waste, and exceptional results.

III. Essential Job Functions

Ensemble Difference Principles

• Customer Obsession: Consistently provide exceptional experiences for our clients, patients, and colleagues by understanding their needs and exceeding their expectations.

• Embracing New Ideas: Continuously innovate by embracing emerging technology and fostering a culture of creativity and experimentation.

• Striving for Excellence: Execute at a high level by demonstrating our “Best in KLAS” Ensemble Difference Principles and consistently delivering outstanding results.

Compliance Investigations Oversight

Leads Investigations team and personally manages investigations including the following:

• Evaluate and manage compliance concerns and reports of suspected misconduct and perform and oversee investigations to ensure that all suspected violations of the Compliance Program are fully investigated and resolved.

• Oversee the intake, triage, prioritization, and assignment of reported compliance matters, ensuring timely and consistent handling in accordance with Compliance Program requirements.

• Coordinate the implementation of corrective action plans, monitoring progress and completion, and escalating as required — including overseeing complex overpayment/refund activities, claim correction efforts, and the resolution of systemic issues.

• Develop and perform training associated with investigations, government and payer coding audits, and settlements.

• Take, research as needed, and respond to day-to-day compliance questions, including providing effective guidance related to Compliance Program requirements and regulatory risk mitigation.

• Maintain awareness of fraud, waste, and abuse laws and regulations and current industry changes that may impact healthcare revenue cycle services domestically and internationally through personal initiative, continuing education, and peer-to-peer networking.

• Prepare and provide reports of investigation activities, findings, and outcomes as requested by Compliance Leadership.

Compliance Liaison Responsibilities In accordance with the Compliance Liaison SOP, this role also serves as a Compliance Liaison to assigned Ensemble clients and/or service lines:

• Serve as the Compliance Liaison to assigned Ensemble clients and/or service lines, as assigned by leadership.

• Act as the primary compliance point of contact for assigned clients and/or service lines, building trusted relationships with client compliance officers and operational leaders.

• Facilitate timely, two-way communication of compliance matters, regulatory updates, and Compliance Program expectations between Ensemble Compliance and assigned clients and/or service lines.

• Attend and support recurring client and service line compliance meetings and align compliance activity with client-specific policies and requirements.

• Identify, triage, and escalate compliance concerns arising within assigned clients and/or service lines, and support resolution and follow-up.

• Support client-facing audit, monitoring, and reporting activities, and coordinate distribution of compliance communications (e.g., the monthly Regulatory Compliance Digest) to assigned stakeholders.

Cloud Solutions Engineer – Azure - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Cloud Solutions Engineer – Azure
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking a skilled Azure Cloud Engineer to design, deploy, and operate large-scale, secure, and resilient cloud platforms on Microsoft Azure. In this role you will own the end-to-end cloud engineering lifecycle, including architecture, infrastructure-as-code, automation, security hardening, cost optimization, observability, and ongoing operational excellence for production workloads. The ideal candidate will combine deep technical expertise across Azure services with strong DevOps engineering practices, and will partner closely with application development, security, and SRE teams to deliver cloud-native solutions that meet demanding business requirements for scalability, reliability, and compliance.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and implement enterprise-grade Azure cloud architectures spanning compute, networking, storage, identity, and data services, with explicit attention to scalability, security, and total cost of ownership.
  • Develop, maintain, and continuously improve infrastructure-as-code using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates, treating infrastructure changes with the same rigor as application code through version control and peer review.
  • Configure and manage Azure landing zones, virtual networks, subnets, route tables, and network security groups to enforce strong segmentation and least-privilege connectivity between workloads.
  • Implement secure identity, access management, and governance controls using Azure Active Directory, conditional access, role-based access control, and Azure Policy to ensure compliance with internal and regulatory standards.
  • Architect and operate Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) clusters, including node pool design, auto-scaling, network policy, and integration with container registries and service meshes.
  • Deploy, scale, and tune Azure data and analytics platforms such as Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Synapse Analytics, Data Factory, and Event Hubs to meet specific workload patterns and SLAs.
  • Build and operate comprehensive CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, enabling fast, automated, and auditable releases of both infrastructure and application code.
  • Design and implement robust observability practices using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, and third-party tooling, with thoughtful dashboards, alerting, and SLO tracking.
  • Drive Azure cost optimization initiatives, including right-sizing, reserved-instance planning, lifecycle policies, and architectural changes that meaningfully reduce monthly cloud spend.
  • Implement disaster-recovery and business-continuity strategies, including backup, geo-replication, failover testing, and documented runbooks that have been validated through regular drills.
  • Strengthen security posture by integrating Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Sentinel, key vault, and managed identities, and by routinely remediating findings from compliance scans.
  • Collaborate closely with application teams to architect cloud-native solutions, advising on patterns, anti-patterns, and Azure-native services that best fit each problem domain.
  • Develop automation scripts and tooling in PowerShell, Bash, and Python to streamline repetitive operational work and reduce time-to-resolution for common incidents.
  • Mentor junior engineers, lead architecture reviews, and contribute actively to internal communities of practice around Azure and DevOps.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of cloud engineering experience, with at least three years focused on Microsoft Azure in production environments.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Azure core services, including compute, storage, networking, identity, and platform-as-a-service offerings.
  • Production-level experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates.
  • Solid experience designing and operating Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) clusters at scale.
  • Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions for CI/CD across infrastructure and applications.
  • Strong scripting skills in PowerShell, Bash, and Python, with the ability to write maintainable automation code.
  • Deep understanding of cloud security principles, identity management, and compliance frameworks.
  • Experience implementing monitoring, alerting, and observability strategies across distributed workloads.
  • Strong troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert or Azure DevOps Engineer Expert certification.
  • Experience operating hybrid cloud or multi-cloud environments spanning Azure and on-premises infrastructure.
  • Familiarity with service mesh technologies such as Istio or Linkerd on AKS.
  • Exposure to FinOps practices and cloud cost-management tooling.
  • Experience with regulated environments such as HIPAA, PCI-DSS, SOC 2, or FedRAMP.
How to Apply

Pepperstone is a leading global forex and CFD broker, headquartered in Melbourne and operating across multiple international markets. Pepperstone's engineering teams build the systems, APIs, and integrations that underpin a high-volume global trading platform. Reliability, performance, and security are non-negotiable — and the backend is where that foundation is built.

About the Role

We are looking for a mid-level Backend Developer with strong PHP experience to join a team that builds and maintains the server-side systems powering Pepperstone's platform. You will be designing and developing APIs, managing data, and ensuring the backend runs reliably at scale. This is a focused backend role — you will not be expected to own the front end, but you will be expected to deeply understand the systems you build and take full ownership of their quality and performance.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Designing, building, and maintaining RESTful APIs and backend services in PHP

  • Writing efficient, scalable, and secure server-side logic that supports a high-volume financial platform

  • Working with relational databases to design schemas, write complex queries, and optimise performance

  • Integrating with third-party services, payment systems, data providers, and internal APIs

  • Collaborating with front-end engineers to ensure seamless integration between systems

  • Participating in code reviews and upholding backend engineering standards across the team

  • Identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks, bugs, and security vulnerabilities

  • Contributing to technical documentation and ensuring codebases are maintainable and well-structured

What You Bring

Essential:

  • 3 to 5 years of backend development experience with a strong PHP focus

  • Deep understanding of RESTful API design principles and best practices

  • Solid experience with relational databases — MySQL, PostgreSQL, or similar — including schema design and query optimisation

  • Strong grasp of security fundamentals relevant to backend systems — authentication, authorisation, data handling, and input validation

  • Experience working with Git in a team development environment

  • Ability to write clean, efficient, and well-tested code

  • Strong analytical and debugging skills with a systematic approach to problem solving

Advantageous:

  • Experience in fintech, trading, or regulated financial services environments

  • Familiarity with microservices architecture or event-driven systems

  • Exposure to cloud infrastructure such as AWS, GCP, or Azure

  • Experience with message queuing systems such as RabbitMQ or Kafka

  • Knowledge of caching strategies using Redis or Memcached

  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and containerisation tools such as Docker

Working Arrangement

Fully remote, work from home. Time zone alignment requirements will be confirmed during onboarding.

raw.description:
Homa is a global mobile game developer and publisher creating games people love. We partner with studios and internally develop games, having launched over 80 titles, reached over 2 billion downloads, and seen our game All in Hole break into the global top-50 grossing charts. These are milestones, not the finish line.

With deep expertise in product and technology, we built Homa Lab, our proprietary platform that gives developers the market intelligence, data tools, and game tech, with AI built-in, to find product–market fit fast and scale mass-market games into lasting experiences players enjoy for years.

This is our flywheel: Homa Lab helps studios spot the right ideas early, turn them into games quickly, and reach millions of players. Every launch brings back data and insights that fuel the next hit, making each turn of the loop faster, smarter, and more likely to win. AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles.

What powers the loop is talent density. 220+ people from 30+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world’s best studios and companies. We uphold ambition, curiosity, humility, and focus, and deliver with speed, excellence, and candor.

Since the start, we’ve raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who’ve built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones.

At Homa, we are building the next billion-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment.

Mission

As a Freelance Concept Artist, you'll play a key role in shaping the visual direction of our upcoming RPG.

Your focus will be on creating compelling character designs for heroes and enemies, following the art style guidelines of our project. Additionally, you will support the art team throughout production, providing concepts for props, environments and UI assets. You will collaborate closely with the Art Director, Game Designers, and production artists to ensure concepts are both visually inspiring and production-ready.

Your main responsibilities will include:

    • Design high-quality concept art for playable heroes, enemies, NPCs, and creatures.
    • Create supporting concepts for props, environments, weapons, UI elements, and other in-game assets.
    • Explore multiple visual directions through sketches, silhouettes, mood boards, color keys, and ideation.
    • Translate gameplay mechanics and design intentions into clear, compelling visual solutions.
    • Work closely with the Art Director to maintain a consistent artistic vision across the project.
    • Produce production-friendly concepts that can be efficiently translated into final game assets.
    • Iterate quickly based on feedback while maintaining a high artistic standard.
    • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, including artists, designers, and AI specialists.

Engagement type: This is a freelance, project-based role with flexible contract durations.

Requirements

We are looking for someone with strong concept art experience in game developmentand the humility, curiosity, ambition, and drive to make an impact fast. You're a great fit if you have:

  • Professional experience creating concept art for games, ideally on RPG, action, fantasy, or stylized titles.
  • Exceptional drawing skills and strong artistic fundamentals, including anatomy, perspective, composition, lighting, color theory, and visual storytelling.
  • Ability to quickly explore multiple ideas while balancing creativity with production constraints.
  • High proficiency in Adobe Photoshop (or equivalent industry-standard digital painting tools).
  • Experience designing a wide variety of assets, including characters, environments, props, creatures, and key illustrations.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with artists, designers, and cross-functional teams.
  • A proactive mindset, openness to feedback, and the ability to iterate efficiently.

Nice to have:

  • Experience working with Unity or game engines.
  • Experience creating paintovers or supporting 3D production workflows.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted creative workflows.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Benefits

Our Culture

At Homa, we prioritize talent, energy, and determination over traditional credentials. We’re building a global community of brilliant, driven people who think boldly, act with pragmatism, move fast, and push boundaries. We believe true innovation comes from diverse perspectives, deep collaboration, and curiosity without limits. Our culture is grounded in four core values:

  • Humility: We recognise that we are always learning, we can always improve and grow - we stay grounded in a clear view of ourselves.
  • Curiosity: We continuously seek the “why” behind the “what” - we explore with purpose and practicality.
  • Focus: Our curiosity takes us deeper, not wider - we obsess over the details and let pragmatism guide our attention.
  • Ambition: We strive for the best - we don’t settle for “good enough,” - we use common sense to reach higher.

Benefits

Building great games starts with building a great place to work. Here’s what you can expect:

  • 🏥 Comprehensive Benefits: Depending on your location, you’ll enjoy a range of perks such as insurance, meal vouchers, public transport, gym memberships, and more.
  • 🏢 Paris HQ Access: Enjoy a desk at our private office in a well-located WeWork building that will give you access to WeWork perks like rooftop view and designed coworking spaces.
  • 🌍 Coworking Access: You will have access to WeWork spaces throughout Europe, along with all their perks and professional office environments.
  • 🌐 Global Team: Collaborate in English with top-tier talent from 35+ countries, spanning Europe, the UK, the US, and more. Diversity fuels our creativity and innovation.
  • ✈️ Team Gatherings: We value time together beyond the screen. Join us for occasional team gatherings, off-site retreats (Workations as we name them) to connect, recharge, and celebrate.
  • 📈 Performance Reviews: We’re committed to your growth. Every six months, we reflect on your progress, recognize your achievements, and align on clear development goals.
  • 💻 Equipment Support: From day one, we’ll provide everything you need to do your best work, including a home office setup allowance if you're working remotely.

About Citylogix

Citylogix is redefining how cities manage infrastructure.

We are an AI-driven platform built for public works teams who need to do more with less. Backed by CRH Ventures, the investment arm of the world’s largest road builder, we already serve 450+ municipalities across the U.S. and Canada... and we’re just getting started. Most asset management systems store data. Citylogix turns it into decisions.

Our platform continuously monitors, analyzes, and prioritizes infrastructure across the entire right-of-way... roads, sidewalks, ADA ramps, signs, pavement markings, and more. Instead of outdated snapshots, cities get a living, real-time understanding of their network and what to fix next. That starts with how data is collected.

Our LiDAR scanning captures high-resolution condition data across entire road networks. With Patrol, our AI-powered mobile app, cities extend that coverage daily... passively collecting intelligence from vehicles already on the road. The result is a system that gets smarter over time, not obsolete the moment it’s delivered. That intelligence doesn’t sit in a dashboard.

It flows directly into capital planning and work order execution... connecting AI-detected issues to budget justification to field crews doing the work. No spreadsheets. No silos. One platform, end-to-end.

No one else owns this full workflow.

We do.

Why this matters for you

We’re not selling another piece of software... we’re helping cities shift from reactive spending to proactive infrastructure management. That’s a massive, underserved market with long-term contracts, real budgets, and clear ROI.

You’ll be selling:

  • A product that solves a visible, everyday problem (every city has bad roads)
  • Into a defined buyer (public works, engineering, DOT)
  • With real differentiation (not just another scanner or dashboard)

And you’ll be doing it at a company that is early enough to matter... but established enough to win!

About the role

Illinois has over 1,200 municipalities and thousands of miles of aging infrastructure. Most are under-resourced, over-budgeted, and in need of smarter asset management solutions. This is a greenfield territory with significant upside and you will be the face of Citylogix in the Prairie State.

But this role is not just about new logos. Citylogix’s strategic direction is full Enterprise Asset Management, so expanding accounts from pavement-only into sidewalks, ADA, signs, ROW assets, and multi-year platform agreements. The right candidate is as comfortable growing an existing account as closing a new one, and understands how to navigate a multi-stakeholder deal across a Public Works Director, City Engineer, and Finance Director.

What you'll do

Territory Ownership & Business Development

  • Identify, prospect, and close new municipal and government agency clients across your territory through outbound prospecting and relationship-building.
  • Develop and execute a territory sales strategy, including pipeline management, forecasting, and account planning.
  • Own the full account lifecycle: close new logos and expand them. From a pavement scan into sidewalks, ADA, EAM platform, and multi-year agreements.

Procurement & Market Navigation

  • Develop deep expertise in municipal procurement processes — RFP cycles, cooperative purchasing vehicles, and public-sector budget cycles.
  • Understand the political and operational dynamics within local government to position Citylogix effectively.

Product Expertise & Client Demos

  • Master the full Citylogix platform from LiDAR data collection and digital twin to EAM, capital planning, and work order management. Work with Sales Engineer to deliver tailored demos that speak to each stakeholder’s priorities: operational credibility for the Public Works Director, methodology for the City Engineer, and cost-avoidance ROI for Finance.
  • Translate complex technology into clear, ROI-driven value propositions for non-technical audiences.

Market Presence & Brand Representation

  • Attend Illinois municipal conferences (ILCMA, IAMMA, ICMA-IL), manage the company booth, and represent Citylogix as a thought leader in the infrastructure and govtech space.
  • Occasionally present or speak on topics relevant to Citylogix and smart city infrastructure.

CRM & Reporting

  • Maintain a clean and up-to-date Salesforce CRM database with accurate pipeline data.
  • Prepare regular sales forecasts and territory reports for leadership.

Team Collaboration

  • Share field intelligence and market feedback to support product and marketing decisions.
  • Contribute to a positive, collaborative team culture and mentor peers when opportunities arise.

Qualifications

Required

  • 5+ years of B2B sales experience in enterprise software or SaaS, with demonstrated ability to manage multi-stakeholder, multi-year deals, not just transactional sales.
  • Proven track record of hitting or exceeding quota and building a book of business from the ground up.
  • Strong understanding of the municipal public sector…how decisions are made, procurement processes, and stakeholder dynamics.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills… you can simplify complex technology for any audience.
  • Self-starter mentality with the ability to operate independently in a remote, field-based role.
  • Salesforce CRM proficiency.
  • Bachelor's degree in business, urban planning, engineering, or a related field or equivalent experience.

Preferred

  • Experience in GovTech, infrastructure technology, pavement management, utilities, GIS, or asset management.
  • Existing network within the Illinois municipal government community; Public Works Directors, City Engineers, City Managers, or DOT contacts.
  • Familiarity with cooperative purchasing programs (e.g., Sourcewell, OMNIA Partners).

Why Citylogix

Competitive Compensation

Base salary plus uncapped commission. Strong performers earn well above target…this is a real earning opportunity for closers.

Greenfield Territory

Your territory is yours to build. No inherited account list…just a large, underserved market and the freedom to develop it your way.

Category-Leading Product

Sell a product that genuinely works and that clients love. Citylogix wins on product quality, ease of use, and demonstrable outcomes.

Strategic Backing

In January 2026, CRH Ventures — the investment arm of CRH, the world’s largest building materials and road construction company — invested in Citylogix. This means the #1 player in the Global Asphalt market made a bet on Citylogix as the top company in the space...No competitor can replicate that claim.

Flexibility & Autonomy

Remote-first with field travel. We care about results, not how you structure your day.

Mission That Matters

Safe sidewalks. ADA-accessible ramps. Smarter roads. Your work helps cities make better decisions for real people every day.

How to Apply

If you are a driven sales professional who understands government and wants to sell technology that genuinely improves cities, we want to hear from you. Please apply directly to this job post.

raw.description:
Hello. We’re Teya.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services has made life harder for them - with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that.

We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe - one built around simple tools, thoughtful design and real human support. Our Members rely on us to help them run their business with confidence, and that responsibility shapes the way we work.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you want to build meaningful products, solve real problems and make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you

Treasury Operations Lead

Your Mission

As Treasury Operations Lead, you will lead Teya's day-to-day treasury operations across eight European markets, ensuring cash moves accurately, securely and efficiently every day.

This is a hands-on leadership role where you'll combine operational excellence with continuous improvement. You'll oversee cash and liquidity management, payment and settlement operations, bank connectivity and treasury controls, while leading a team responsible for ensuring Teya's treasury operations scale alongside our business.

Working closely with Finance, Accounting, Accounts Payable, General Ledger, Banking Partners and Finance Transformation teams, you'll strengthen controls, drive automation and build a best-in-class treasury operations function.


Responsibilities


Treasury Operations

  • Lead the day-to-day treasury operations across multiple European entities.

  • Own daily cash positioning, liquidity management and short-term cash forecasting across corporate bank accounts.

  • Ensure all entities remain appropriately funded while optimising cash movements across the Group.

  • Execute, authorise and monitor treasury payments and settlements within agreed cut-off times.

  • Resolve payment exceptions and failed transactions with banking partners and internal stakeholders.

  • Support accurate and timely treasury reconciliations and month-end close activities.

Controls & Governance

  • Maintain and strengthen the treasury operations control framework.

  • Ensure robust segregation of duties, payment security and fraud prevention controls.

  • Maintain compliance with internal treasury policies and governance standards.

  • Support internal and external audits through accurate reporting and documentation.

  • Ensure treasury reporting and reconciliations are delivered accurately and on time.

Process Improvement & Automation

  • Standardise treasury operations processes across multiple European markets.

  • Drive automation initiatives to improve efficiency, reduce manual effort and strengthen controls.

  • Enhance bank connectivity through Host-to-Host, API and SWIFT solutions.

  • Partner with Finance Transformation and Technology teams to improve treasury systems and straight-through processing.

  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency as Teya continues to scale.

Leadership

  • Lead, coach and develop the Treasury Operations team.

  • Create a high-performing culture focused on accuracy, service, controls and continuous improvement.

  • Prioritise workloads while supporting the team's ongoing development and capability building.


How You'll Make an Impact

  • Ensure payments and settlements are executed accurately and on time across Europe.

  • Maintain strong liquidity management and reliable short-term cash forecasting.

  • Strengthen treasury controls, governance and audit readiness.

  • Increase automation and operational efficiency across treasury processes.

  • Build a scalable treasury operations function capable of supporting Teya's continued growth.

  • Develop an engaged, high-performing Treasury Operations team.


Requirements

  • We're looking for someone who brings:

  • Strong experience in treasury operations, cash management or payment operations within a multi-country environment.

  • Experience within payments, fintech, banking or an e-money/PSP business.

  • Hands-on knowledge of treasury management systems, ERP platforms (SAP preferred), bank portals and payment connectivity including SWIFT, APIs or Host-to-Host solutions.

  • Strong understanding of treasury controls, payment security, reconciliations and cash management.

  • Experience leading or mentoring treasury operations teams.

  • Excellent analytical skills with a passion for process improvement and automation.

  • A meticulous, controls-focused approach with the ability to perform under pressure.

  • Strong communication skills with experience partnering across Finance and external banking partners.

  • A degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or a related discipline.

  • Treasury qualifications (ACT/CertT) are advantageous.

  • Fluent English; additional European languages are a plus.


What We Offer

  • Competitive salary.

  • Flexible hybrid working.

  • Health Insurance.

  • Life Insurance.

  • Meal Allowance.

  • Wellhub membership, providing access to gyms, fitness, therapy, wellbeing and nutrition services.

  • Enhanced maternity and paternity leave.

  • 25 days annual leave.

  • Continuous learning and professional development opportunities.

  • Collaborative, informal and high-performing working environment.

  • Regular company and team events.

  • The opportunity to play a critical role in building a scalable, best-in-class treasury operations function supporting Teya's continued growth across Europe.

Teya is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or background can thrive and do their best work. We believe that a diverse team leads to better ideas, stronger outcomes, and a more supportive workplace for all.

If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process whether for interviews, assessments, or other parts of the application—we encourage you to let us know. We are committed to ensuring that every candidate has a fair and accessible experience with us.

description: The OpportunityFutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to lead Maestro, an AI-native inventory-planning intelligence venture.

raw.title: Co-Founder & CEO - AI Retail Planning Autopilot
raw.excerpt: The OpportunityFutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to lead Maestro, an AI-native inventory-planning intelligence venture.
raw.description:
The Opportunity

FutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to lead Maestro, an AI-native inventory-planning intelligence venture. This is a co-founder partnership with meaningful founder equity, not a salaried executive role.

Maestro is an autopilot planning intelligence for SMB operators managing physical inventory complexity without a planning team. It connects across channels and ERPs, handles routine decisions silently, and surfaces exceptions with context and a recommended action before they become revenue losses. The institutional memory that today lives only in a planner's head gets externalized, structured, and queried in plain language.

We didn't just build a thesis; we validated it directly with the market. We have spoken with founders, VP E-Commerce leaders, merchandise planners, and multi-channel operators at DTC and specialty retail brands across the US. The market signal is clear:

  • Autopilot is the vision: Every named competitor generates recommendations that humans still have to act on manually. No product at this revenue tier is building toward full autonomous execution of the planning lifecycle. Maestro's product vision is full autopilot: the system owns the buy decision, allocation, and markdown trigger end-to-end. But buyers earn that trust incrementally, starting with routine decisions handled silently and exceptions surfaced with context.
  • The pain is in the dollars, not the dashboards: Documented annual losses across just five buyer accounts total $1.25–1.5M+. Buyers currently spend $0–500/month on software; the entire planning budget is tied up in headcount. The payback case is immediate, and ROI demonstration, not feature demos, will be the critical sales motion.
  • Institutional memory failure is systemic and unresolved: One SVP with 30 years of domain expertise described relying entirely on personal recall to flag which materials, colours, and styles underperformed last season. When he leaves, that knowledge disappears, and no tool captures it today. Every buyer interviewed described a version of this problem.

Market Context

We are targeting a large, structurally underserved segment: SMB operators managing multi-channel physical inventory complexity at $5M–50M revenue — importers, distributors, Amazon aggregators, and specialty retailers. The beachhead SAM is estimated at $200M–$225M across approximately 15K–16K brands in the US and Canada. Excel is the universal incumbent! 5/5 buyers in our discovery sprint were on spreadsheets, with zero dedicated planning tools in use. EBITDA across the $10–50M DTC cohort is compressed to 7.25% in 2025 with revenue declining ~4.6% YoY. Planning waste attacks the margin stack directly.

About FutureSight

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.

You’ll co-create with a proven studio team, led by John Carbrey (4x entrepreneur, $100M ARR), Krista LaRiviere (3x exited, E&Y Top Women Entrepreneur), Alan Smith (Strategyzer co-founder, $120M in products built), Prathna Ramesh (former MD of Maple Leaf Angels, $275M in follow-on capital), and Johnny Tong (0-to-1 builder, acquired by SAP and Stripe) bring a rare combination of operator exits, institutional investing, and AI product depth.

The Partnership

  • Founder equity with meaningful ownership from inception
  • Pre-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow-on funding
  • Venture building resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one
  • Investor and advisor network across vertical AI and early-stage capital markets
  • A true co-creation model in which you operate as CEO with FutureSight's cross-functional team as your partner

What You’ll Own

As Co-Founder & CEO, you will set the venture's direction and lead its execution.

  • Strategy — Refine the ICP, pricing model, and product positioning
  • Customer Development — Lead pilots with VPs, operations managers, and merchandise planners at importers, distributors, and multi-channel retail brands, convert them to paid engagements, and build the go-to-market motion
  • Product — Partner with the FutureSight product and engineering team to ship V1 and iterate on user feedback
  • Capital — Lead the seed raise, supported by FutureSight's network and traction
  • Team — Recruit and lead the founding team, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

Co-Founder Profile

  • Previous founding experience at a venture-backed company
  • Demonstrated success in B2B SaaS go-to-market, including sales and customer engagement
  • Fundraising fluency, with the ability to develop investor narratives and close capital
  • Proven ability to attract, develop, and retain top talent
  • Clear-eyed understanding of the risks and demands of co-founding a venture-backed company
  • Deep, operational exposure to merchandise planning, inventory management, and multi-channel retail operations

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

About the role

  • Our Technical Consultant will work as part of a team assisting customers in making best use of the Atlassian product suite such as Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket, and other related productivity technologies, such as Slack, in order to deliver value to their business or organisation.

    This role will be helping customers to integrate systems, automate processes, and achieve efficiencies. This typically ranges from providing expert guidance and solution design to “hands-on” work with product setup, migrations, upgrades and performance tuning.

    As an Atlassian Technical Consultant, the role will also take part in pre-sales - offering solutions, providing estimates and producing proposals. The position will naturally involve maintaining and improving knowledge of the Atlassian product suite, related technologies, and other collaborative tools such as Slack.

What you'll be doing

Atlassian Solution Consultancy

  • Use knowledge of Atlassian products to gather and analyse requirements, research and present solutions to clients, and make suitable recommendations
  • Communicate regularly with a range of stakeholders
  • Participation in pre-sales, helping define scope and estimates for projects as well as helping in solution design
  • Participation in internal knowledge-sharing and improvements
  • Travel to client sites and working on site where necessary

Atlassian Solution Implementation and Delivery

  • Installations, upgrades, migrations for Atlassian applications and associated technologies
  • Custom Atlassian solution design and implementation e.g., workflow, plugins/scripts, configuration
  • Scripting solutions with languages like Groovy and Python
  • Database administration and querying
  • Web integration of Atlassian and other applications using Rest APIs
  • System administration (Linux and Windows), particularly application servers

What we're looking for

  • German proficient is a must
  • Migrations experience
  • Experience in technical consulting, with background of Atlassian toolsets is a must
  • Scripting experience in Scripturnner or with a language like Groovy or Python
  • Experience with system administration (e.g. Linux and Bash scripting) and database operations
  • Experience in cloud infrastructure setup like AWS, Google cloud and Azure
  • Strong written and spoken English language skills
  • Experience presenting solutions to customers based on provided requirements
  • Experience writing and contributing to technical reports
  • Excellent organizational, prioritization, communication, and interpersonal skills
  • An ability to think innovatively and creatively
  • Team player and strong collaboration skills
  • Self-starting, strongly ambitious and tenacious

A few nice to haves

  • Experience with web integration using Rest APIs
  • Experience in AI or Atlassian Rovo
  • Experience in other tools including Gitlab, , SNOW and serviceNow
  • Experience in developing Atlassian Apps

Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At ScriptRunner, part of TAG, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply, even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet.

Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!

What to expect

We have published some support on Interviewing with us to try to alleviate any pre-interview anxieties, here you’ll find information to help you prepare and ace an interview at TAG.

You can read them here

Working at The Adaptavist Group

The Adaptavist Group is a global family of companies with a common goal. We combine the best of teamwork, technology, and processes, helping all kinds of businesses be better today and tomorrow.

We are experts at delivering enterprise software, tailored solutions, and quality services across some of the world’s most trusted technology ecosystems, including Atlassian, AWS, Slack, GitLab, monday.com and Aha!

We make change happen. From anywhere.

What we offer you

We offer a very generous holiday (PTO) allowance, trusting you to take vacation time that suits your personal life, alongside flexible working hours that empower you to work when it best fits you and your team. We provide MacBooks to all employees and additional support for fully remote workers to set up their home offices.

Our exceptional Time Away Policy includes 26 weeks of fully paid leave for birthing parents, 13 weeks for non-birthing parents, and extended leave for adoption, IVF, surrogacy, elective egg freezing, and women's health needs such as menopause, menstruation, endometriosis, and PCOS.

Our trusting, flexible, remote-first way of working means that work can fit around your life, rather than your life fitting around work.

Read our full list of benefits

Description

AcisTek is seeking qualified professionals to support the Grants.gov Information Technology Services program for the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, Office of Grants, Division of Information and Solutions. Grants.gov is a highly visible, public-facing federal shared service that provides a centralized platform for applicants to find and apply for federal discretionary grant opportunities and for federal agencies to post, manage, and process grant application packages.

The selected candidate will support the operation, maintenance, enhancement, modernization, security, performance, and user experience of the Grants.gov system. raw.title: Principal Network Engineer
raw.excerpt: About Montera At Montera, we’re building the future of digital infrastructure.
raw.description:
About Montera

At Montera, we’re building the future of digital infrastructure. Founder-led with $1.5B backed by Stonepeak, Montera is driven by a future-focused vision: to develop and operate hyperscale data centers essential for tomorrow's technology. Our mission is to deliver strategically located, hyperscale data centers designed for speed, reliability, and scalability. Backed by decades of experience in design, construction, and operations, we don’t just build—we execute with purpose.

Our Values

  • Client First Alignment: We align every solution to our clients’ goals.
  • Speed with Certainty: Velocity matters. We deliver with urgency and precision.
  • Operational Excellence: Decades of experience drive our high standards.
  • Safety & Integrity: Safety is non-negotiable. We lead with integrity and transparency.
  • Ownership Mentality: We think like owners, because we are.

The Opportunity

Montera is seeking a Principal Network Engineer to owns the architecture, security, and governance of all Montera-operated networking — spanning corporate IT, critical-infrastructure OT (BMS, SCADA, DCIM, life-safety), administrative, guest, and Wi-Fi networks — and the secure demarcation to customer-managed fabrics. This role owns Montera’s public IP strategy: ARIN/RIR address application and justification, ASN and BGP strategy, IPAM, and the governance of all network allocations, firewalls, and security policy across the fleet.

The role works hand-in-glove with the Principal Controls Engineer. Controls defines the data — the points, tags, and exposure scope Montera surfaces to itself and to the customer; Network delivers the secure transport, segmentation, and demarcation that lets that data be consumed without compromising OT. Montera facilities are single-tenant — one customer per building or campus — so the customer data-access model (what the customer sees, how they reach it, and where the trust boundary sits) is defined with that single customer and governed jointly by these two roles. Neither can deliver it alone.

What You'll Do

Internal Network Architecture (IT / OT / Guest)

  • Own and standardize all Montera-operated networks: corporate IT, OT controls (BMS/SCADA/DCIM), life-safety interfaces, administrative, guest, and Wi-Fi.
  • Define segmentation, zoning, and isolation strategy across IT, OT, and customer domains (e.g., Purdue-model / IEC 62443 alignment for OT).
  • Establish redundancy and survivability standards for mission-critical internal services, monitoring transport, and management networks.

IP Strategy, Addressing & Allocation Governance

  • Own the public IP strategy: ARIN/RIR address-space application and justification, ASN acquisition, and BGP/peering/transit strategy for Montera-operated services.
  • Own IPAM and the governance of all address allocations across sites — internal, OT, shared services, and Montera-side customer handoff ranges.
  • Define addressing, routing, and DNS standards that scale cleanly across a multi-site portfolio.

Security, Firewalls & Critical Infrastructure Networking

  • Own firewall architecture and policy, secure remote-access patterns, role-based access control, micro-segmentation, and audit logging across IT and OT.
  • Design high-security architectures for OT and critical-infrastructure systems; partner with controls, cybersecurity, and operations on baseline hardening, monitoring, and incident-response workflows.
  • Lead risk reviews of exposure paths between customer, IT, and OT domains and drive mitigations through design and governance (supporting Montera’s ISO 27001 posture).

Customer Data Access & Demarcation

  • Executed jointly with the Principal Controls Engineer.
  • Translate the controls-defined data-exposure scope into the secure delivery path: DMZ/broker placement, read-only least-privilege boundaries, firewall policy, and the customer-facing network demarcation for OT/telemetry data.
  • Define demarcation models, handoff points, and clear IT/OT/customer responsibility boundaries between Montera-operated shared infrastructure and customer-managed fabrics.
  • Provision the secure network path for AI optimization platforms (e.g., Phaidra) consuming Montera telemetry — edge, on-prem, or cloud — in partnership with the Controls Engineer.
  • Support customer technical reviews and acceptance testing for data-access and connectivity commitments tied to leases and SLAs.

Customer AI & Compute Networking Enablement

  • Engage the customer directly to capture AI/compute networking requirements: fabric type, bandwidth, latency, scale, storage connectivity, and operational model.
  • Translate customer requirements into deployable designs within facility constraints (space, pathways, power/cooling, operational standards).
  • Define the demarcation between Montera-operated shared infrastructure and customer-managed compute/storage fabrics, with clear handoff and responsibility.

Delivery, Commissioning & Operations Readiness

  • Define configuration, documentation, and automation standards (IPAM, addressing, routing, access control) using Git-based / infrastructure-as-code workflows.
  • Support construction and commissioning milestones: testing, validation, and turnover readiness for internal and shared-service networks.
  • Establish observability standards and operational runbooks for troubleshooting and incident response.

Vendor Strategy & Standardization

  • Lead technical evaluation and selection of network OEMs, firewall/security, Wi-Fi/access, and cabling/optics partners for Montera-owned systems.
  • Drive standardization and cost-optimized BOM strategy aligned to availability, lead time, power, and operational risk.
  • Own technical change control and vendor issue resolution through deployment and lifecycle support.

Requirements

Who You Are:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Controls, Electrical, Mechanical, or Systems Engineering, or related field (Master’s preferred).
  • 10+ years of experience designing and operating data center networks for hyperscale, mission-critical, or regulated environments.
  • Direct experience with RIR/ARIN address application and justification, ASN/BGP, and enterprise IPAM at multi-site scale.
  • Deep firewall, segmentation, and secure-remote-access expertise across both IT and OT (BMS/SCADA/DCIM), with IT/OT segmentation and IEC 62443 / Purdue-model familiarity.
  • Proven experience defining single-tenant customer demarcation and data-access models in secure environments.
  • Strong customer-facing capability: translating requirements into implementable designs and clear demarcation models.
  • Network automation and configuration management (Git-based workflows, templating, infrastructure-as-code).

Benefits

Why Join Montera?

At Montera, you’ll shape the next generation of digital infrastructure while being supported by a team that values integrity, collaboration, and long-term partnership. We’re a remote-first company that empowers our people with flexibility, ownership, and meaningful rewards.

Compensation:

At Montera, we believe great work starts with investing in great people. That is why we offer a competitive and thoughtful total compensation package designed to recognize the value each team member brings.

Our compensation ranges are informed by market data and aligned to job level and role. When making hiring and compensation decisions, we consider a variety of factors, including skills, experience, education, training, competencies, and overall business needs.

The reasonable compensation range for this role is $160,000 - $220,000.

Our Benefits at a Glance:

  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: We pay 90% of health premiums for employees and their dependents.
  • Generous Time Off: Up to 8 weeks of paid time off per year, which includes holidays, PTO, and sick time.

Job ID: 16000

Alternate Locations:

Newell Brands is a leading consumer products company with a portfolio of iconic brands like Graco®, Coleman®, Oster®, Rubbermaid®, Sharpie® and Yankee Candle® - and 24,000 talented teammates around the world. Our culture is built on values in action: Integrity, Teamwork, Passion for Winning, Ownership, and Leadership. We work together to win, grow, and make a real impact—supported by a high-performing, inclusive, and collaborative environment where you can be your best, every day.

About Newell Brands

Newell Brands is a leading global consumer goods company with an iconic portfolio that includes Rubbermaid, Sharpie, Graco, Coleman, Oster, Contigo, Yankee Candle and more, serving consumers and commercial customers in 200+ countries. Engineering, Reliability & Automation (ERA) partners with product development, supply chain and operations across six business segments to build manufacturing excellence, insourcing capability and competitive cost into every new product.

Role Overview

The Manager, Design for Manufacturing (DFM) is an individual contributor leadership role that owns the development, deployment and continuous improvement of Newell’s DFM program within ERA. Working with New Product Development (NPD), Manufacturing Development & Commercialization (MDC), Operations and cross-functional teams, this role embeds manufacturability into NPD decisions where cost, lead time and supply chain risk can be most effectively shaped. This role owns the DFM review cadence: calling the reviews, setting agendas, driving cross-functional conversations to decisions and initiating escalation when a program is at risk of missing gate criteria.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Manage and improve Newell DFM materials, including the Program Manual, phase definitions, RACI, KPI framework and template library.
  • Own DFM gate criteria from Idea through Launch; drive programs to meet them and deliver the DFM readiness assessment at each gate, concentrating on the decisions that most affect cost, lead time and complexity.
  • Support make-vs-buy and insourcing decisions by helping teams quantify capital, capability and risk trade-offs and grounding design choices in data.
  • Support consistent DFM application across segments while developing product-type guidance for discrete electromechanical, discrete mechanical/formed, process/batch and high-volume discrete products.
  • Act as the DFM lead on priority NPD programs during rollout; guide business teams and MDC through day-to-day execution and hold programs accountable to the DFM standard.
  • Lead cross-functional DFM reviews with Product Development, ERA, Packaging, Industrial Engineering, Plant/Production, Quality, Procurement and Finance; own the cadence, set agendas, drive reviews to decisions and initiate escalation when program timing or gate readiness is at risk.
  • Build and maintain a Subject Matter Expert (SME) network supporting DFM reviews across Product Development, MDC, Manufacturing, Quality, Packaging, Procurement, Finance and plant teams.
  • Define and maintain SME engagement guidelines for DFM reviews, including timing, cadence and role clarity by program phase.
  • Capture and codify SME guidance, lessons learned and manufacturing constraints, including closeout learnings, into DFM materials and training to continuously improve effectiveness.
  • Define, track and communicate DFM KPIs, including manufacturability risk, cost-to-target, supplier readiness, design-freeze compliance, pilot first-pass yield and skills readiness.
  • Build and deliver DFM training and develop the skills-and-training-readiness approach so operator, technician, engineering and supplier capabilities are assessed and closed before launch.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Industrial or a related Engineering discipline.
  • 5+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing engineering, product development or operations in consumer products or discrete/process manufacturing.
  • Experience applying DFM and/or other Design for Excellence (DFX) disciplines, such as Design for Assembly, Cost, Quality, Reliability or Supply Chain.
  • Experience with concurrent engineering and embedding manufacturability into a structured, stage-gated NPD process.
  • Experience implementing, scaling or governing a program, standard or capability across multiple sites or business units from a corporate or center-of-excellence role.
  • Working knowledge of DFM and quality tools, including DFMEA, PFMEA, process capability fundamentals and structured cost analysis.
  • Familiarity with enterprise PLM systems (e.g., PTC Windchill), engineering change process, 3D modeling and CAD/eBOM management.
  • Strong facilitation, influence and communication skills in a matrixed organization; able to explain manufacturability trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 7+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing engineering, product development or operations in consumer products or discrete/process manufacturing.
  • Advanced degree, such as an MS in Engineering or MBA, and/or certification such as Six Sigma Black/Green Belt, PMP or ASCM/APICS.
  • Direct experience supporting, scaling or governing DFM, DFX, APQP or design-assurance programs across multiple sites, functions or business units.
  • Breadth across multiple manufacturing contexts. Examples include discrete electromechanical (appliances), process/batch (candles, cleaning) and high-volume discrete (writing instruments).
  • Familiarity with AIAG APQP, PPAP, AIAG-VDA FMEA, Manufacturing Readiness Levels (MRL) and the Boothroyd-Dewhurst DFMA methodology.

Work Environment

This role operates in a fast-paced, matrixed environment spanning corporate functions, business segments and plant operations. The DFM program is scaling from center-led execution toward business-team ownership, requiring adaptable, hands-on candidates who can build standards and tools while demonstrating them on live programs. Travel to Newell manufacturing and development sites is required. Success depends on collaboration, clear communication and commitment to Newell’s values of Integrity, Teamwork, Passion for Winning, Ownership and Leadership.

“The Remote base pay range for this position is from $111,200 to $152,900. Salary will be based on prior experience related to the skills required for this position.”

Newell Brands (NASDAQ: NWL) is a leading global consumer goods company with a strong portfolio of well-known brands, including Rubbermaid, Sharpie, Graco, Coleman, Rubbermaid Commercial Products, Yankee Candle, Paper Mate, FoodSaver, Dymo, EXPO, Elmer’s, Oster, NUK, Spontex and Campingaz. We are focused on delighting consumers by lighting up everyday moments. Newell Brands and its subsidiaries are Equal Opportunity Employers and comply with applicable employment laws. EOE/M/F/Vet/Disabled are encouraged to apply.

About Grupo QuintoAndar

We are Grupo QuintoAndar, the largest real estate ecosystem in Latin America. Guided by a shared purpose of helping people love where they live, we have a diversified portfolio of brands and solutions across different countries in Latin America, covering all phases of the housing journey. We also have a Technology Hub in Portugal. We develop technology and innovation to transform and enhance the overall living experience.

With the support of a world-class team of investors and advisors, including Kaszek, Qualcomm, General Atlantic, and SoftBank, Grupo QuintoAndar is currently valued at over USD 5.1 billion and continues to grow year over year.

Here, you will work with top professionals in the market, in an environment that breathes innovation, collaboration, and high performance. To learn more about our story, visit:.


Location & Remote Work

Our technology team operates under a "remote-first" model, which means we work from home and can live anywhere in Brazil. We also offer the option of working from our São Paulo offices or partner coworking spaces, up to twice a week.

About the Position

We are looking for a leader to take on the role of Manager of Information Security, GRC. Your mission will be to define the area's vision, structure our practices, and lead the transformation: shifting the perception that GRC is merely an operational and bureaucratic function to making it a dynamic, strategic enabler focused on real business risk.

This is not a position for managing spreadsheets. As the GRC leader within the Cybersecurity structure, you will work side-by-side with the CISO and others leadership to safely enable critical projects. We seek someone with technical capability, execution skills, and strategic vision, able to drive projects end-to-end and ensure that security governance makes our business faster, more scalable, and resilient.

You must have proven experience in GRC leadership that goes beyond regulatory compliance and paper-based frameworks, understanding control architectures and the technological nuances of an agile, cloud-native environment (Cloud, AI, Data). You will be primarily responsible for accountability regarding cyber risk, guiding the company through complex scenarios.

The Manager of GRC will report directly to the CISO and will be responsible for managing the investment, the internal team, and the third-party (3P) partners supporting the GRC operation.

Main Responsibilities

  • GRC Leadership & Strategy: Develop and lead the GRC strategy, building and executing roadmap in full alignment with the company's business objectives, budget, and risk appetite.
  • Security Service Channel & Portfolio: Own the company's security service channel and security portfolio, acting as the primary intake and coordination point for security requests and initiatives, ensuring visibility and prioritization across the security program.
  • Information Security Governance & Artificial Intelligence: Lead the Information Security Governance model. Take the lead in AI governance, establishing guidelines, controls, and policies to ensure the safe, ethical, and compliant use of new technologies across the company.
  • IAM Governance: Lead IAM Governance projects, ensuring identity and access management controls and processes are aligned with the company's risk and SOX compliance requirements.
  • People Management & Development (EM): Lead, inspire, and develop a high-performance team of GRC specialists, promoting engagement, autonomy, and technical excellence.
  • Operationalized Risk Management: Lead the end-to-end cyber risk management program (identification, treatment, monitoring, and remediation plans), with strong ability to financially quantify cyber risk using methodologies such as FAIR (Factor Analysis of Information Risk).
  • Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) & Cyber Resilience: Lead third-party risk management and cyber resilience programs, ensuring the extended supply chain and critical vendors meet the company's security and compliance standards.
  • Continuous Compliance: Ensure compliance with regulations (e.g., LGPD, SOx, GDPR) and frameworks, acting as the company's voice to respond to and negotiate with internal and external audits and regulatory bodies, implementing a Continuous Compliance model.
  • Committees & Metrics (KPIs/KRIs): Act as a member of the Information Security Committee, defining and reporting strategic, tactical, and operational indicators, risk metrics, and maturity evolution to executive leadership and supporting the preparation of materials for these forums.
  • Culture & Awareness: Lead the corporate security awareness strategy, transforming the human factor into the first line of defense through engaging programs and metrics that prove a reduction in behavioral risk.
  • Policies (ISP): Structure, simplify, review, and maintain the framework of policies, standards, procedures, and processes related to Information Security.
  • Partnership & Focal Point: Act as the primary focal point and business partner for GRC topics with Technology, Engineering, Product, Legal, Privacy, Finance, Compliance, Internal Audit, and business leaders. Identify opportunities to build practical, structural processes that mitigate risks.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience in Information Security GRC, with at least 5 years in leadership and team management roles within complex, dynamic, and multinational corporate environments (preferably tech companies, scale-ups, or the financial sector).
  • Experience managing security demand intake and portfolio prioritization, ideally leveraging ITSM practices.
  • Deep mastery and critical vision in structuring frameworks and standards such as NIST CSF 2.0, ISO 27001/27002, CIS Controls, SOX and ISO 31000.
  • Exceptional ability to translate technical cyber risks into financial and operational impacts using methodologies such as FAIR.
  • Experience designing and operationalizing security KPI/KRI frameworks and maturity models for executive reporting.
  • Experience designing vendor risk assessment methodologies and TPRM programs.
  • Experience leading IAM Governance initiatives, ensuring identity and access management controls and processes are aligned with the company's risk and compliance requirements.
  • Experience supporting SOX compliance programs, including IT General Controls (ITGC).
  • Experience designing and running security awareness and behavior change programs.
  • GRC Engineering mindset: ability to use automation and AI to solve GRC problems at scale (e.g., automated evidence collection, continuous controls monitoring, risk quantification), reducing manual and bureaucratic work.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and advanced English.

Nice to have

  • Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor will be considered a differential.

raw.description:
Hi 👋 We’re Legl.

Legl is building the operating system for modern legal services.

We help law firms and regulated businesses replace manual, fragmented workflows with intelligent software from client onboarding and compliance to payments, risk, and reporting.

Legal work is high-stake - it’s regulated, complex, and deeply impactful - and our mission is to help regulated firms grow faster, run their businesses more profitably, manage risk intelligently, and deliver great client experiences

We’re backed by leading European VCs, scaling quickly, partnered with over 600 law firms including 50 of the UK’s top 200, launched in the UK and Australia - and entering our next phase of growth.

We Work Best When

  • AI is the central-operating model:not a tool or a future plan - but the way we run.

  • Decisions live with people:you're trusted to make calls and own them.

  • Think deeply, execute quickly:speed and rigour, not speed or rigour.

What You’ll Do

As aSupport Executiveat Legl, you’ll:

  • Be the first line of support.Work through a broad range of customer and technical queries across onboarding, compliance, payments and reporting, diagnosing the root cause independently and escalating cleanly when needed.

  • Guide firms and their clients through the product.Walk firm users through complex features and AML/CDD workflows as a calm, credible expert, and help their end-clients complete their journey smoothly.

  • Be AI-first. Use AI tools to draft and maintain help centre content, speed up troubleshooting, and get more done in less time.

  • Iterate & improve as you go.Spot patterns in tickets and feedback, propose fixes to clunky processes, and feed clear insight to Product and EPD to fix recurring issues at source.

  • Own your work end to end.Manage your own queue and priorities, communicate proactively with customers and the team through incidents and change, and flag issues early rather than reactively.

This Role Is a Great Fit If…

  • You're a genuinely strong communicator - clear and confident with law firm customers, their end-clients and internal colleagues alike, in writing and live, and calm under pressure.

  • You're proactive with communication - you share progress, flag problems early, and escalate when you need help rather than letting issues surface reactively.

  • You're self-directed and accountable - you can own a project end to end, take a brief and run with it without close supervision.

  • You manage your own time well - balancing customer-facing support with internal commitments and knowing what to prioritise.

  • You're a self-learner - you pick up new products, tools and regulatory domains independently, without waiting to be taught.

  • You're improvement-minded - you notice where a process is clunky and propose a better way, even if you're not the one who builds it.

  • You're a technically curious problem-solver who enjoys turning a frustrated customer or client into a confident one.

This Role Is Not a Great Fit If…

  • You're not a confident communicator, or you go quiet internally and don't escalate when you need help.

  • You don't flag when you're struggling - issues tend to surface reactively rather than being raised early.

  • You need close, ongoing supervision and struggle to take ownership of a project end to end.

  • You struggle to manage your own time or to prioritise between customer support and internal requirements.

  • You wait to be taught rather than learning independently, and you don't tend to spot or propose process improvements.

  • You'd rather deal with only one type of audience, or you're uncomfortable supporting less technical end-clients directly.

  • You're wary of AI, or you prefer a narrow, script-driven remit in a stable, slow-moving environment.
