  • Serve as a subject matter expert on Microsoft partner programs, tools, and processes, including OA 3.0 (MDOS, CAT, DPC, and DOC).
  • Escalate, track, and manage technical issues and inquiries through Microsoft tools and support channels to ensure timely resolution.
  • Oversee the onboarding process for new partners, coordinating training, resources, and cross-functional support.
  • Design and deliver partner training programs, webinars, workshops, and educational initiatives that improve partner capabilities and readiness.
  • Identify and manage the platforms, tools, and resources required to support partner success.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with partners, acting as a trusted advisor and primary point of contact.
  • Conduct regular business reviews and enablement sessions to support partner growth and success.
  • Gather partner feedback, evaluate program effectiveness, and implement continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, code of conduct, and quality standards.

  • Perform additional responsibilities assigned by leadership consistent with the nature of the role.

Requirements

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, Telecommunications, Computer Science, Information Technology, Networking, Process Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum 7 years of professional experience, including at least 5 years of experience in Microsoft platform implementation, configuration, technical support, or partner enablement environments.
  • Experience working with Microsoft technologies, partner ecosystems, or software channel partners.
  • Strong understanding of Microsoft platforms and partner-related processes.
  • Knowledge of OA 3.0 processes and tools (MDOS, CAT, DPC, DOC).
  • Experience managing KPIs, operational performance metrics, and service delivery objectives.
  • Experience collaborating with customer stakeholders.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills.
  • Advanced English proficiency (C1 or equivalent).
  • Native or professional Mandarin proficiency.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and presentation skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Project Management certification or specialization.
  • Experience supporting Microsoft licensing, partner programs, or channel operations.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft 365, Windows Server, Azure fundamentals, Office solutions, and IoT technologies.
  • Experience designing and delivering technical training programs.
  • Additional certifications related to Microsoft technologies, partner programs, or project management.
  • Experience working within a global technology services environment.
Key Competencies
  • Customer orientation and partner success mindset.
  • Outstanding verbal and written communication.
  • Problem-solving and decision-making.
  • Results orientation.
  • Quality and continuous improvement mindset.
  • Information analysis and research.
  • Collaboration and teamwork.
  • Adaptability and stress tolerance.

Benefits

Location: Remote
Employment Type: Full-Time Independent Contractor (Service Provider)

Why Join Echez?
  • Work with a global network of technology partners and industry leaders.
  • Contribute directly to partner growth, adoption, and business success.
  • Gain exposure to Microsoft technologies, programs, and partner ecosystems.
  • Be part of a people-focused organization that values innovation, learning, and excellence.
If you have a strong technical background, a passion for partner success, and expertise in Microsoft technologies and enablement programs, we’d love to hear from you. Join Echez and help empower partners to grow, innovate, and succeed in today’s evolving technology landscape.

raw.excerpt: The OpportunityFutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to lead Crossfoot, an AI-native accounting agent platform.
raw.description:
The Opportunity

FutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to lead Crossfoot, an AI-native accounting agent platform. This is a co-founder partnership with meaningful founder equity, not a salaried executive role.

Crossfoot is agentic accounting for small-to-mid CPA firms; a segment where accountant shortages are structural, client intake is capped by production headcount, and the manual close and tax prep workflow consumes the majority of senior staff capacity. Crossfoot connects to the tools firms already use (QuickBooks Online, Xero, Drake) and delivers finished work products ready for partner review, without requiring system migration or enterprise-scale implementation.

Market Context

  • We didn't just build a thesis; we validated it directly with the market. We've spoken with CPA firm managing partners, CAS leads, and tax preparers. The key insights:
  • The "why now" is structural, not hype: the profession lost 300,000+ professionals from 2020–2024, and the replacement pipeline has shrunk ~33% in a decade. Firms now cap new-client intake by production headcount rather than demand. They turn away winnable work they can't staff. Meanwhile, CAS (advisory) revenue is projected to reach 30% of the firm's revenue by 2026.
  • Senior accountants spend 40%+ of their time on document intake and workbook compilation — $90K staff doing $20/hour data entry — while month-end close runs 10–15 business days on a pure manual process.
  • Early AI adopters in accounting already earn 39% more revenue per employee. The gap between firms that move and firms that don't is compounding now.
  • We are targeting a large, fragmented, structurally underserved market. The total addressable market is an estimated $1.5B+ across 87,000+ US accounting firms, with a focused beachhead SAM of $400M+ (small/mid firms).

About FutureSight

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.

You’ll co-create with a proven studio team, led by John Carbrey (4x entrepreneur, $100M ARR), Krista LaRiviere (3x exited, E&Y Top Women Entrepreneur), Alan Smith (Strategyzer co-founder, $120M in products built), Prathna Ramesh (former MD of Maple Leaf Angels, $275M in follow-on capital), and Johnny Tong (0-to-1 builder, acquired by SAP and Stripe) bring a rare combination of operator exits, institutional investing, and AI product depth.

The Partnership

  • Founder equity with meaningful ownership from inception
  • Pre-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow-on funding
  • Venture building resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one
  • Investor and advisor network across vertical AI and early-stage capital markets
  • A true co-creation model in which you operate as CEO with FutureSight's cross-functional team as your partner

What you'll own

As Co-Founder & CEO, you will set the venture's direction and lead its execution.

  • Strategy — Refine the ICP, size-tiered pricing model, and product positioning
  • Customer Development — Lead pilots with managing partners, CAS leads, and outsourced-accounting/BPO operators at small-to-mid CPA firms, convert them to paid engagements, and build the referral-led go-to-market motion
  • Product — Partner with the FutureSight product and engineering team to ship V1 and iterate on user feedback
  • Capital — Lead the seed raise, supported by FutureSight's network and traction
  • Team — Recruit and lead the founding team, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

Co-Founder Profile

  • Previous founding experience at a venture-backed company
  • Demonstrated success in B2B AI or B2B SaaS go-to-market, including consultative, relationship-driven sales and customer engagement
  • Fundraising fluency, with the ability to develop investor narratives and close capital
  • Proven ability to attract, develop, and retain top talent
  • Clear-eyed understanding of the risks and demands of co-founding a venture-backed company
  • Deep accounting domain expertise, with hands-on experience managing close processes, tax preparation, workpapers, and client accounting services within CPA firms.

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

raw.description:
Prosper Health is on a mission to make life happier and healthier for autistic and neurodivergent adults.

Despite autism diagnoses increasing more than 5x in the past 25 years, autistic adults have been systematically overlooked. This has led to extremely poor outcomes, including high rates of co-occurring mental health conditions and a lower life expectancy. Prosper is here to change that.

We deliver specialized mental health services for autistic adults, covered by insurance. We've helped tens of thousands of people receive an autism diagnosis for the first time, work with neurodivergent-affirming therapists, and find belonging through community. Our outcomes meaningfully outperform traditional care for autistic adults, with substantially greater improvements in mood, anxiety, and quality of life.

Prosper is growing 3x year over year and are at mid-double-digit millions in run-rate revenue, with thousands of active clients and 400+ clinicians. We're a high-ownership, mission-driven team, building something that has never existed for autistic and neurodivergent adults.

The Opportunity

We're hiring Licensed Mental Health Therapists (LCSW, LPC, LMHC, LMFT) to provide therapy for autistic and neurodivergent adults via telehealth. You'll join a team dedicated to creating affirming, accessible mental health services for the neurodivergent community.

Our clinicians come from diverse backgrounds and career stages - whether you're passionate about neurodiversity advocacy, seeking flexibility and better work-life balance, or looking to add specialized experience to your existing practice, we offer roles to match your professional goals.

Why Therapists Choose Prosper:

  • Focus on what matters most: Provide exceptional client care while we manage administrative tasks, insurance billing, and client acquisition
  • Enjoy scheduling flexibility: Design your work schedule to accommodate personal needs and maintain optimal work-life balance
  • Scale your practice quickly: Build your caseload with steady client referrals during your first few weeks, with most clinicians reaching their ideal caseload within 4-6 weeks
  • No-show and late cancellation reimbursement: Receive 50% reimbursement for late cancellations and no-shows
  • Grow professionally: Access regular peer consultation, specialized training, and monthly case conferences
  • Neurodiversity-affirming environment: Work alongside clinicians who share your commitment to neurodiversity-affirming approaches
  • Connect with a supportive clinical community: Join weekly drop-ins and engage in a tight-knit clinical community that prevent isolation

We offer two distinct position types to accommodate different career needs and scheduling preferences

Scheduling Availability

  • Set your own schedule, 7 days a week, between 7am and 10pm
  • No required evening, weekend or on-call hours
  • Build your schedule around your life, not the other way around

Full time (Benefits-Eligible)

  • Hours: Provide 25+ hours of weekly availability to build a caseload of 25+ clients
  • Ideal for: Those who seek steady, predictable income that grows with your client base
  • Compensation: Competitive hourly rate paid per session
  • Benefits: Comprehensive benefits package including Medical/Dental/Vision coverage, 401(k) retirement plan and PTO.

Part-Time Position

  • Hours: Provide 15+ hours of weekly availability to build a caseload of 15+ clients
  • Ideal For: Practitioners with existing commitments who want to diversify their practice or add specialized neurodiversity experience to your clinical portfolio
  • Compensation: Competitive hourly rate paid per session

Who We're Looking For

Qualifications:

  • Licensed independent mental health professional (LCSW, LPC, LMHC)
  • Strong clinical skills in evidence-based modalities such as CBT, DBT or ACT
  • Interest in working with autistic or neurodivergent adults
  • Comfort with technology and virtual care platforms (Zoom, EHR, Slack)
  • Excellent communication skills and commitment to client-centered care
  • Telehealth experience preferred but not required

You'll Thrive Here If:

  • You identify with our mission to support the neurodivergent community
  • You're seeking better work-life balance without sacrificing meaningful clinical work
  • You're transitioning from a demanding in-person setting and want more flexibility
  • You want to maintain multiple practice settings and add specialized experience
  • You're passionate about providing affirming care to traditionally underserved populations

Compensation

Our transparent model means your income grows with your client relationships. Unlike traditional salary models, our fee-for-service approach rewards you directly for the sessions you provide. The more sessions you complete, the more your practice thrives – with the security of guaranteed income during no-shows and cancellations.

Join Our Team

Ready to transform lives while advancing your career? Apply today to join Prosper Health's team of dedicated professionals making a real difference for autistic and neurodivergent adults.

Prosper Health is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, including those who identify as neurodivergent, LGBTQ+, or BIPOC.

Competitive W2 rate paid per session. 50% reimbursement for late cancellations/no shows. Paid every 2 weeks for the sessions you provide, no waiting for payment or reimbursement. Benefit Eligible roles available that include Medical/Dental/Vision/401k/PTO

W2 Per Session Rate
$55—$60 USD

More about Prosper Health

  • Our culture is a unique mix of thoughtfulness, kindess, and high-performance. We set ambitious goals and hold ourselves accountable to achieving them.
  • We always ensure that we integrate perspectives from experts in our space, including clinicians and autistic self-advocates.
  • Our team members come from places such as Bain, McKinsey, BCG, FirstHand Health, Rula, SeatGeek, Benchling, and schools like Harvard, MIT, Stanford, Yale, Penn, Dartmouth, Northwestern, Vanderbilt, and more.
  • Here are a few of our favorite operating principles:
    • Clients first - Our job is to solve real problems for our clients. Choose what makes life better for the client, even if it’s harder for us. Never lose sight of the person on the other side.
    • Find a Way - We use ingenuity, scrappiness, and determination to bend the world to accomplish our goals. We’re resourceful and do more with less.
    • Raise the Bar - We grow deliberately, by asking how things can improve and by giving and seeking feedback. We insist on the highest standards and keep pushing them higher.
    • Be a Good Person - Be kind, be honest, and make it fun to work here. Tell the truth even when it’s uncomfortable. Treat people with respect and go out of your way to do nice things for your teammates.

We understand your time is valuable, so we strive to keep the assessment process under 45 minutes whenever possible, though some roles may require a slightly longer time investment.

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

Our client is building the infrastructure that enables humanitarian organizations to use stablecoins without requiring blockchain expertise.

Rather than building another wallet or payment application, we're creating an orchestration layer that connects donors, NGOs, compliance providers, blockchain networks, regulated financial institutions, and local payout providers through a single API.

Blockchain is the infrastructure—not the product.

Our platform orchestrates the complete payment workflow, including:

  • Funding and treasury management
  • Compliance and sanctions screening
  • On-chain transactions
  • Reporting and audit trails
  • Beneficiary payouts
  • Local off-ramp integrations

We integrate best-in-class providers for custody, compliance, blockchain connectivity, and financial settlement instead of replacing existing financial infrastructure.

About the Engagement

This role begins as a project-based contract focused on delivering key milestones for an upcoming pilot.

The initial engagement is deliverables-based, with clearly defined objectives and timelines. Upon successful completion of the pilot and continued platform growth, there is a strong opportunity to transition into a long-term full-time engineering role.

You'll work directly with the founding team and Technical Lead, helping shape the architecture and technical direction of the platform.

Where the Platform Stands

Our MVP is approximately 80% complete.

Already Live
  • NGO onboarding and authentication
  • Wallet connectivity
  • Stablecoin payment initiation
  • Compliance screening
  • On-chain transaction execution

Current Technology Stack

Frontend

  • Next.js
  • React
  • TypeScript
  • Vercel

Backend

  • Node.js
  • Supabase
  • PostgreSQL

Blockchain

  • WalletConnect
  • USDC
  • Arbitrum
  • Base

Note: The pilot network may transition to Stellar, so experience with both EVM and non-EVM ecosystems is highly valuable.

What You'll Deliver

During the pilot engagement, you'll be responsible for taking the platform from MVP to production.

Production Readiness
  • Production hardening and infrastructure improvements
  • Encryption at rest and in transit
  • Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
  • Comprehensive audit logging
  • Security reviews and penetration testing

Platform Development

Build and complete several core platform components, including:

  • Off-chain audit records
  • Donor reporting dashboard
  • Treasury workflows
  • Local off-ramp integrations
  • Payment orchestration APIs

Blockchain Engineering
  • Develop and integrate secure smart contracts using audited standards such as OpenZeppelin
  • Expand the chain abstraction layer across:
    • Ethereum
    • Stellar
    • Arbitrum
    • Base
    • Tempo
  • Support both EVM and non-EVM blockchain ecosystems

Transaction Security

Design and implement:

  • Transaction approval workflows
  • Operational guardrails
  • Secure wallet interactions
  • Risk controls
  • Blockchain transaction monitoring (e.g., Chainalysis or similar)

Requirements

We're looking for a senior engineer with hands-on production experience building blockchain-enabled applications.

Strong experience with
  • Node.js
  • TypeScript
  • REST APIs
  • Next.js
  • React

Blockchain
  • Ethereum
  • Smart contract development
  • Multi-chain applications
  • EVM ecosystems
  • Wallet infrastructure
  • WalletConnect
  • RPC providers such as Alchemy or QuickNode

Security

Experience implementing:

  • Encryption
  • RBAC
  • Audit logging
  • Secure key management
  • Production-grade security practices

Language
  • Professional working proficiency in Arabic for collaboration with partners and stakeholders across Arabic-speaking operating regions.

raw.title: RPT Medical Science Liaison
raw.excerpt: At RayzeBio, every day is an opportunity to ignite meaningful change.
raw.description:
At RayzeBio, every day is an opportunity to ignite meaningful change. As a wholly-owned subsidiary of Bristol Myers Squibb, RayzeBio blends the nimble, pioneering spirit of an emergent biotech with the global expertise and resources of a leading innovator in oncology. Our mission is to develop transformative radiopharmaceutical therapies that offer new hope for patients living with cancer. Here, you’ll join a multidisciplinary team where your ideas are valued, your expertise is amplified, and collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. From day one, expect to make an immediate impact—on our science, on our teams, and most importantly, on patients. Learn more about RayzeBio:

RayzeBio, a Bristol Myers Squibb company, is a dynamic biotechnology company headquartered in San Diego, CA. The company is focused on improving survival of people with cancer by harnessing the power of targeted radioisotopes. RayzeBio is developing innovative drugs against targets of solid tumors. Led by a successful and experienced entrepreneurial team, RayzeBio aims to be the global leader in radiopharmaceuticals

We are seeking a Radiopharmaceutical Medical Science Liaison (RPT-MSL) for RayzeBio to serve as a trusted, agile partner to the Thought Leader community. This role is well-suited for a highly motivated, “hungry learner” with a strong scientific foundation and a growth mindset, who is looking to build core field medical capabilities.

The RPT-MSL will engage in authentic, peer-to-peer scientific dialogue with RPT Thought Leaders and healthcare professionals, contributing to RayzeBio’s scientific presence while developing confidence and effectiveness in external engagement. With appropriate guidance, structure, and coaching, the individual will build foundational competencies in scientific exchange, territory planning, and stakeholder engagement.

Through these interactions, the RPT-MSL will begin to generate and communicate valuable insights to inform clinical strategy, evidence generation, and launch readiness. This role offers an opportunity to develop into an independent, strategic field medical partner while contributing to RayzeBio’s mission of advancing innovative radiopharmaceutical therapies for patients in need. Led by a successful and experienced team, RayzeBio aims to be the global leader in radiopharmaceuticals.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build Scientific Partnerships: Facilitates scientific interactions and partnerships with Thought Leaders and HCPs including the multidisciplinary nuclear medicine team at top RPT institutions
  • Liaise with institutions to understand clinical and RPT-unique levers and barriers to patient access in the context of clinical trials
  • Lead high-impact scientific discussions and presentations that challenge conventional thinking and advance the standard of care. Educate on real-world evidence and clinical trial read-outs to key opinion leaders.
  • Support clinical development: identify and recommend sites for trials, engage with investigators and site staff to educate on the trial and asset and identify barriers to enrollment. Deliver solutions that address the barriers and support enrollment.
  • Gather Early, Actionable Insights: Conduct insight‐gathering sessions to uncover emerging clinical or diagnostic/imaging needs, treatment paradigms and barriers to optimal patient care. Translate frontline feedback into strategic recommendations
  • Demonstrates a strong learning orientation with high motivation to grow within a field medical role
  • Builds foundational competencies in scientific exchange, territory planning, and stakeholder engagement
  • Engages in peer-to-peer scientific dialogue with appropriate preparation and support
  • Operates effectively within a structured environment, leveraging guidance, tools, and coaching
  • Shows early ability to develop external relationships while building confidence and presence
  • Asset Advisory & Launch: Act as a scientific partner to medical and commercial/sales colleagues, guiding medical education and external engagement.
  • Applies AI to improve team execution and decision‑making

Qualifications & Experience

  • Advanced scientific degree (MD/PhD/PharmD/NP/PA), with oncology clinical expertise highly preferred
  • 2-5+ years of relevant experience in oncology and/or RPT with a minimum of 3 years of field experience with an RPT or solid tumor product
  • Demonstrated curiosity, coachability, and strong learning agility in a scientific or clinical environment
  • High level of motivation, resilience, and ability to adapt in a fast-paced, evolving field-based role
  • Proven track record of external engagement with national and global Thought Leaders.
  • Scientific agility: ability to engage in a peer-to-peer dialog about data in a fair and balanced way.
  • Expert knowledge of clinical practice and evolving healthcare delivery models. Understands treatment paradigms and can frame information in a convincing way that resonates with physicians
  • Customer/Commercial Mindset: results-oriented, positive, resilient attitude, able to quickly adapt in an ever-changing environment. Demonstrated ability to drive organizational performance. Experience identifying, engaging, and cultivating relationships with TLs and compliantly partnering with commercial/sales team.
  • Teamwork/Enterprise Mindset: Ability to work independently and act as a team player by developing strong rapport and working relationships with external and internal stakeholders. Holds a high level of integrity and good judgment, in order to navigate the requirements of the role effectively and compliantly in accordance with RayzeBio’s policies and procedures.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills to articulate scientific and clinical data in an easy-to-understand manner to help HCPs best serve their patients
  • Has a strong mindset and passion for science. Prioritizes staying current with the latest data
  • Willing to travel up to 50% of the time

If you come across a role that intrigues you but doesn’t perfectly line up with your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway. You could be one step away from work that will transform your life and career.

Remote - United States - US: $149,860 - $181,595

The starting compensation range(s) for this role are listed above for a full-time employee (FTE) basis. Additional incentive cash and stock opportunities (based on eligibility) may be available.   • Financial Well-being and Protection: 401(k) plan, short- and long-term disability, life insurance, accident insurance, supplemental health insurance, business travel protection, personal liability protection, identity theft benefit, legal support, and survivor support.

raw.excerpt: We are Hiring! We have an exciting new opportunity at Scope for a Supplier Quality Manager to join our team!
raw.description:
We are Hiring!

We have an exciting new opportunity at Scope for a Supplier Quality Manager to join our team!

We are looking for people who can connect their own personal vision and values into some of what we do at Scope.

Our vision as a company is to become a leading force in Eyecare, with people at our core.

Please read below the full job description for the role and if this is something that you would be interested in, please click apply and a member of the Scope team will be in touch regarding your application.

Supplier Quality Manager

Working within the Quality Department, the Supplier Quality Manager is responsible for supplier-facing processes to ensure that SCOPE’s suppliers are properly qualified and managed.

This is a remote position requiring regular global travel. The post holder should be comfortable travelling internationally for up to 50% of their time.

Please note, we are open to candidates located in the UK, IRL and the USA.

Key Responsibilities

· Lead the compliant and efficient operation of the following systems / processes:

o Supplier Qualification

o Supplier Management

o Supplier Auditing

o Development of Quality Technical Agreements with suppliers and customers

o Supplier Corrective Actions (SCAR)

· Support the wider Quality function to ensure compliant and efficient operation of wider QMS systems and processes.

· Promote a culture of continual improvement within the team and wider company by:

o Championing root cause analysis and use of appropriate risk management tools throughout all activities.

o Coaching others to help them understand how their day-to-day activities relate to the Quality Policy and Quality Objectives.

o Ensuring that all processes and working practices within your area of responsibility are constantly reviewed and any compliance or efficiency improvements are implemented in a timely fashion proportional to the risks identified.

o Ensure all procedures relating to the systems you are responsible for are kept up-to-date and reflect both internal and external best practices.

· Support the wider Quality function by:

o Ensuring adherence to Health and Safety, Good Manufacturing Practice and other relevant guidelines and legal obligations.

o Supporting team members to develop their skills and functional expertise.

· Ensure delivery of activities within your area of responsibility to ensure customer and business targets are met.

· Act as a peer reviewer to check and approve work generated within your own and the wider quality team.

o Ensure any corrections or errors are fed back to the author of the work in a constructive manner with a view to preventing recurrence.

· Act as a functional trainer within the wider team.

Key Performance Indicators

· All Quality Objectives are consistently met for all processes and systems within your area of responsibility,

o Rapid and appropriate corrective actions taken to address any drift from Quality Objective targets,

o Evidence of evolution of processes to meet current best practice and increase efficiency.

· No avoidable or repeat incidents / deviations associated with processes and systems within your area of responsibility.

· Processes are operated to meet business and customer expectations and targets.

· Performance and contribution are regularly reviewed, with appropriate action taken to recognise good performance and correct areas requiring development.

Qualifications

Essential:

  • Experience of carrying out supplier audits in at least one regulated industry (e.g. medicines or medical devices. Cosmetics and/or food supplement auditing may also be considered with extensive experience)

Desirable:

  • Experience of carrying out supplier audits in multiple regulated industries (e.g. medicines, medical devices, cosmetics, food supplements),
  • Experience of delivering and managing Critical/Major audit findings,
  • Experience of negotiating Quality Technical Agreements or similar contractual documents with third parties,
  • Experience of quality supplier liaison/management.

Specific Knowledge, Skills and Experience

Key Capabilities

  • Excellent attention to detail,
  • Good analytical and problem-solving abilities,
  • Detailed knowledge of root cause analysis and risk management tools and their application,
  • Good understanding of applicable regulations, standards and best practices,
  • Good communication, interpersonal and influencing skills,
  • Good numerical skills and the ability to handle and analyse data,
  • Sound knowledge of data analysis tools (e.g. Excel, Minitab),
  • The ability to present complex information (both internally and externally) to diverse audiences and levels of understanding,
  • Planning and project management skills,
  • Ability to travel up to 50% of the time.

You’ll be an integral part of the team, helping to ensure data integrity is continuously maintained and resolving discrepancies as they arise. As a demonstrated self-starter, you’ll own business processes end-to-end and will lead the identification and implementation of best practices.

raw.description:
8x8 connects our customers and teams globally, empowering CX leaders with performance and insights to make smarter decisions, delight customers, and drive lasting business impact.

8x8 is seeking a Product Manager to own two of the most consequential domains in our Finance Technology organization: ERP, Billing & Core Finance Platforms and Revenue & Monetization Platforms. This is not a traditional enterprise IT PM role. You will be the product conscience of systems that directly govern how 8x8 prices, bills, recognizes revenue, and closes its books.

You will sit at the intersection of Finance, Engineering, and go-to-market — translating complex monetization requirements into system architecture decisions, driving billing accuracy, and enabling the organization to move faster on pricing changes without sacrificing revenue integrity. You will work closely with the Director of Finance Technology and partner daily with functional leads across ERP, billing, RevRec, and integrations.

What You'll Own

ERP, Billing & Core Finance

Own the product roadmap for 8x8's billing engine (Logisense), order-to-cash workflows, and ERP systems (Netsuite GL/AP/AR)
Drive billing accuracy initiatives — reduce invoice defect rate, credit memo volume, and billing reruns through structured product improvements
Partner with the Billing/O2C functional specialist and ERP functional analyst to translate Finance requirements into prioritized engineering backlog
Define and track KPIs: invoice defect rate, ERP uptime, days-to-close trend, % automated journal entries, cash application automation

Revenue & Monetization Platforms

Own the product roadmap for pricing architecture, subscription lifecycle logic, and RevRec systems
Drive monetization agility — reduce time to launch new pricing models and enable pricing changes without external consultants
Ensure revenue integrity across the billing-to-RevRec pipeline, targeting zero restatement incidents and minimizing billing-to-RevRec variance
Support tax automation extension and evaluate pricing system requirements for potential M&A integration scenarios
Define and track KPIs: time to launch new pricing models, RevRec restatement incidents, billing-to-RevRec variance rate, post-release defect rate

What We're Looking For
Required Experience
6+ years in product management, with at least 3 years owning enterprise finance systems — ERP, billing engines, or revenue recognition platforms in a SaaS company
Hands-on experience with Netsuite (GL/AP/AR) or equivalent ERP, and a billing engine (Logisense, Zuora, or similar) — able to speak to configuration tradeoffs, not just outcomes
Fluency in order-to-cash and lead-to-cash flows — you can diagram the journey from a quote in Salesforce to a posted journal entry in the ERP without prompting
Working knowledge of ASC 606 and how RevRec system configuration drives compliance — you understand allocation logic, performance obligations, and restatement risk
Track record of driving billing accuracy and close efficiency improvements through system change, not just process workarounds
Experience partnering directly with Finance, Accounting, and Revenue Operations stakeholders — you speak their language and can translate business constraints into engineering requirements

Strongly Preferred
Experience with SFDC CPQ or equivalent quoting/pricing configuration
Familiarity with tax integration systems (Avalara, Vertex) and how configuration changes propagate through billing and ERP
Experience working in a hybrid matrix org model with matrixed engineering resources

Key Competencies

Systems Thinking

Revenue Integrity

Stakeholder Management

Monetization Architecture
Backlog Discipline
ERP Configuration Literacy
M&A Readiness
Data-Driven Prioritization

Cross-functional Influence

The Team You'll Work With
You'll join Finance Technology organization — a lean, high-accountability team of functional domain leads, billing and ERP specialists, and matrixed engineering across application, integration, data, and AI disciplines. The team is mid-transformation: several major platform migrations are underway (Logisense, CPAAS billing, Paymentus/Gaviti interface), and the roadmap over the next 12 months is ambitious.

This role is a critical hire. You will bring product rigor to a domain that has historically been led by strong functional operators — and you will raise the bar on roadmap predictability, delivery accountability, and executive stakeholder communication.

Why This Role
Greenfield opportunity to introduce modern product management practice into a finance systems org that is ready for it
Active, high-stakes roadmap — you won't be maintaining a stable system; you'll be building and migrating critical infrastructure
Collaborative org model with clear domain accountability and strong engineering partners
Competitive compensation, equity, and benefits

The compensation range reflects the Company’s good faith belief at the time of posting. 8x8 has different base pay ranges for different work locations within the United States, which allows us to pay employees competitively and consistently in different geographic markets. The range above reflects the potential base pay across the U.S. for this role; the applicable base pay range will depend on what ultimately is determined to be the candidate’s primary work location. Further, individual base pay depends on various factors, in addition to primary work location, such as complexity and responsibility of role, job duties/requirements, and relevant experience, knowledge, success, education and skills. Base pay ranges are reviewed and typically updated each year. Offers are made within the base pay range applicable at the time. Certain roles are eligible for additional rewards, including discretionary merit increases, bonus and/or stock. Certain roles have the opportunity to earn sales variable compensation incentives based on the terms of the plan and the employee’s role.

$130,400.00 - $195,600.00

raw.excerpt: The AMER Service Governance team is responsible for driving the service governance framework across the Americas region by overseeing service level performance, governance cadence, reporting, and issue management.
raw.description:
The AMER Service Governance team is responsible for driving the service governance framework across the Americas region by overseeing service level performance, governance cadence, reporting, and issue management. The team ensures leadership has clear visibility into operational performance while supporting continuous service improvement.

Reporting to the Service Governance Lead, you will be responsible for coordinating governance activities, monitoring service performance, tracking key metrics, and ensuring governance processes are executed consistently across the region.

Key Responsibilities

Governance Cadence & Reporting

  • Coordinate and manage the AMER governance cadence, including Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), service review meetings, governance forums, and operational dashboards.
  • Prepare governance reports, meeting materials, and performance summaries for internal stakeholders.
  • Ensure governance activities are delivered accurately and on schedule.

SLA & KPI Monitoring

  • Monitor Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) across regional services.
  • Identify performance trends, highlight risks, and escalate SLA breaches where appropriate.
  • Maintain governance dashboards and provide regular reporting to leadership.

Issue & Escalation Management

  • Track operational issues, risks, and escalations through to resolution.
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure timely follow-up and closure of action items.
  • Maintain accurate records of governance decisions, issues, and mitigation plans.

Continuous Improvement

  • Support root cause analysis for recurring operational issues.
  • Assist in identifying opportunities to improve governance processes, reporting, and service delivery.
  • Contribute to regional initiatives that enhance operational efficiency and service quality.

Stakeholder Management

  • Build effective working relationships with regional operational teams and business stakeholders.
  • Coordinate governance meetings and ensure follow-up actions are completed.
  • Support leadership by providing accurate governance reporting and operational insights.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Timely execution of governance meetings and review cadence.
  • Accuracy and timeliness of SLA and KPI reporting.
  • Issue and escalation resolution tracking.
  • Completion of governance action items.
  • Stakeholder satisfaction with governance support and reporting.
  • Continuous improvement initiatives delivered.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Project Management, or a related field.
  • 4–6 years of experience in Service Delivery, Service Governance, Operations, PMO, Business Operations, or a related function.

Ми поєднуємо технічне SEO, лінкбілдінг, роботу з брендовою видачею та створення власних веб-продуктів. Наше завдання полягає в тому, щоб покращувати видимість брендів у пошуку та AI-відповідях і підтверджувати результат конкретними метриками.

Зараз шукаємо SEO-спеціаліста у delivery-команду, який допоможе масштабувати цей напрям разом із засновником компанії. У цій ролі буде свобода в прийнятті рішень, доступ до необхідних ресурсів і можливість впливати на розвиток процесів та методології.

Це можливість працювати над AI SEO як основною спеціалізацією, розвивати експертизу в напрямі, попит на який зростає, та бачити безпосередній результат своєї роботи.


Що ви будете робити:

  • Аналізувати, як бренд відображається у ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini та Google AI Overviews.

  • Аналізувати брендову видачу в Google, Bing, Brave та знаходити точки для покращення.

  • Будувати активи під результат, сателіти, PBN, сторінки, посилання, потрібні сайти.

  • Працювати над покращенням AI Visibility брендів.

  • Вимірювати appearance rate до і після, тримати результат відтворюваним.

  • Співпрацювати із засновником і підрядниками для реалізації SEO-стратегії.

Очікуємо що ви:

  • Маєте 1–2 роки практичного досвіду в SEO, лінкбілдингу та побудові сіток сайтів (PBN/сателітів), який можете підтвердити власними кейсами.

  • Володієте технічним SEO та повністю самостійно працюєте з доменами, хостингом, CMS і запуском сайтів без залучення розробника.

  • Маєте досвід або готові швидко зануритися в brand probing в AI-пошукових системах, аналіз SERP і брендової видачі, а також вимірювання appearance rate.

  • Використовуєте AI-інструменти (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini тощо) для SEO-досліджень, автоматизації та оптимізації робочих процесів.

  • Готові працювати з підходами, що виходять за межі класичного white-hat SEO, та відкриті до роботи в ніші iGaming.

  • Володієте англійською мовою на рівні B1+.

  • Досвід роботи в iGaming буде перевагою.

Що пропонуємо ми:

  • Свободу в прийнятті рішень та відсутність бюрократії.

  • Доступ до ресурсів.

  • Гідну оплату праці та прозору бонусну систему.

  • Гнучкий і віддалений формат роботи.

  • Курси англійської мови.

  • Тімбілдінги та корпоративні заходи.

  • Забезпечення автономності роботи. Надаємо ресурси, завдяки яким блекаути не завадять твоїй роботі.

  • Оплачувані відпустки та лікарняні.

Ми вважаємо нашою соціальною відповідальністю робити внесок у розвиток суспільства через допомогу тваринам.

Наш проєкт Playduck Charity активно займається підтримкою ініціатив, які спрямовані на допомогу безхатнім тваринам. Сьогодні, наша команда допомагає створювати кращі умови для проживання в 30 притулках по всій Україні.
Від самого початку своєї діяльності, ми впроваджуємо соціальні ініціативи, що націлені на підтримку та поліпшення життя тих, хто цього найбільше потребує.

raw.description:
SAP MM Consultant – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: SAP MM Consultant
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $130,000–$190,000 Annually
Experience Required: 7+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced SAP MM Consultant to lead the implementation, enhancement, and support of enterprise SAP Materials Management (MM) solutions supporting global procurement, inventory management, warehouse operations, and supply chain initiatives. This role focuses on delivering scalable SAP S/4HANA MM solutions that streamline Procure-to-Pay (P2P) processes, vendor management, material planning, and inventory optimization across enterprise environments.
You will work closely with procurement teams, supply chain leaders, warehouse operations, finance stakeholders, SAP functional consultants, and technical teams to design and configure SAP MM solutions that improve procurement efficiency, inventory visibility, and operational performance. The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in SAP MM configuration, cross-functional integration, and SAP S/4HANA transformation projects while maintaining a strong understanding of end-to-end Procure-to-Pay business processes.

Key Responsibilities
  • Analyze business requirements and design scalable SAP MM solutions supporting procurement and supply chain operations.
  • Configure SAP Materials Management components including Purchasing, Inventory Management, Material Master, Vendor Master, Valuation, and Invoice Verification.
  • Lead end-to-end implementation and enhancement projects across Procure-to-Pay (P2P) business processes.
  • Configure organizational structures including plants, storage locations, purchasing organizations, purchasing groups, valuation areas, and company codes.
  • Configure material types, material groups, account determination, release strategies, valuation classes, and movement types.
  • Design and configure procurement processes including purchase requisitions, purchase orders, contracts, scheduling agreements, RFQs, and source determination.
  • Configure inventory management processes including goods receipts, goods issues, stock transfers, physical inventory, and cycle counting.
  • Collaborate with ABAP developers to prepare Functional Specifications for reports, interfaces, enhancements, workflows, BADIs, User Exits, IDOCs, and forms.
  • Integrate SAP MM with SD, PP, FI/CO, WM, EWM, QM, PM, and Ariba modules.
  • Support SAP S/4HANA migration projects, system upgrades, testing, cutover activities, and post-go-live support.
  • Develop functional documentation including Business Process Documents (BPDs), Functional Specifications, Configuration Documents, and Test Scripts.
  • Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis, and provide ongoing application support.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, solution design workshops, architecture reviews, and continuous process improvement initiatives.

Required Skills
  • Seven or more years of hands-on SAP MM consulting experience supporting enterprise SAP implementations.
  • Strong expertise in SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA Materials Management configuration.
  • Extensive knowledge of Procure-to-Pay (P2P) business processes.
  • Hands-on experience configuring Purchasing, Inventory Management, Invoice Verification, Material Master, Vendor Master, and Procurement processes.
  • Strong experience configuring material types, purchasing document types, release procedures, movement types, valuation classes, account determination, and pricing procedures.
  • Experience configuring procurement processes including RFQs, Contracts, Scheduling Agreements, Purchase Orders, and Vendor Evaluation.
  • Strong understanding of inventory management, warehouse operations, stock transfers, physical inventory, cycle counting, and inventory valuation.
  • Experience integrating SAP MM with FI/CO, SD, PP, QM, WM, EWM, PM, and Ariba.
  • Experience preparing Functional Specifications for ABAP developments including Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, Forms, and Workflows (RICEFW).
  • Familiarity with IDOCs, BAPIs, RFCs, APIs, EDI, and middleware integration technologies.
  • Experience supporting integrations with supplier portals, procurement platforms, warehouse management systems, and third-party logistics providers.
  • Experience with SAP Solution Manager, ChaRM, SAP GUI, and SAP Fiori.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and business process optimization skills.
  • Experience working in Agile Scrum or SAP Activate implementation methodologies.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience participating in multiple full lifecycle SAP S/4HANA implementation or migration projects.
  • Familiarity with SAP Fiori Apps, SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), and SAP Integration Suite.
  • Experience with SAP Ariba, SAP Supplier Lifecycle Management (SLM), and SAP Business Network.
  • Knowledge of SAP Extended Warehouse Management (EWM), Warehouse Management (WM), and Transportation Management (TM).
  • Experience supporting global procurement and supply chain organizations.
  • Familiarity with Material Requirements Planning (MRP), Demand Planning, and Supply Chain Planning processes.
  • Experience integrating SAP with Coupa, Jaggaer, Salesforce, MuleSoft, Boomi, or other enterprise applications.
  • SAP Certified Application Associate or SAP Certified Professional certification in SAP MM or SAP S/4HANA Sourcing and Procurement is highly desirable.
  • Experience supporting manufacturing, automotive, pharmaceuticals, healthcare, retail, or consumer goods industries.
  • Knowledge of SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), procurement reporting, and operational analytics is a plus.

Project Environment
You will be joining a global SAP transformation program responsible for modernizing procurement, inventory, and supply chain operations across multiple business units. Current initiatives include:
  • SAP S/4HANA Greenfield and Brownfield implementation projects
  • Enterprise Procure-to-Pay (P2P) process transformation
  • Global procurement standardization and vendor management optimization
  • SAP Ariba and supplier collaboration platform integration
  • Warehouse Management (WM) and Extended Warehouse Management (EWM) modernization
  • Inventory optimization and Material Requirements Planning (MRP) enhancements
  • SAP Fiori application rollout for procurement and warehouse users
  • Enterprise workflow automation for purchasing approvals
  • Cloud-based SAP integrations using SAP BTP and Integration Suite
This is a hands-on functional consulting role where you will contribute to solution architecture, SAP MM configuration, procurement process optimization, system integration, testing, production support, and continuous improvement of enterprise supply chain platforms.

How to Apply

Would you like to know more about this opportunity? For immediate consideration, please send your resume to or contact us at (908) 676-4399. Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at .
